div.div: One person sends a friend request. Friend Service rejects a request to yourself and creates a pending request on a canonical, sorted pair of user ids, so A to B and B to A can never both exist; a unique-conflict is recovered to the existing row. The app then updates its lists and suggestions.

exist; a unique-conflict is recovered to the existing row. The app then updates its lists and suggestions.
